title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.8 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 17.8 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users with planner-role permissions to set a future merge scheduling date on merge requests they authored. This capability should have been restricted to users with developer-role permissions or higher. The issue was due to insufficient permission enforcement on the merge scheduling field during merge request updates.
